title: 2 suspected drug personalities killed in Sulu buy-bust

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Two suspected drug personalities were killed following an armed encounter with anti-drug operatives during a buy-bust operation in Patikul, Sulu, on Saturday afternoon. The suspects, identified only as alias “Masul,” estimated to be between 45 and 50 years old, and alias “Basir,” aged between 50 to 55 years old, were both residents of Barangay Sandah, Patikul. Bryan Babang, Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-Region 9 (PDEA-9) director, disclosed that the operation took place around 12:30 p.m. on Nov. 21 in the vicinity of Barangay Sandah.
